summary: The overridden.yaml test removes config, populates, runs overridden, asserts before/commands/after with symmetric_difference, reruns to check idempotency, and always cleans up.
questions: How do I write an idempotency test for a resource module?
How can I compare expected and actual commands in an assert?

answer_card.title: Example overridden test case
answer_card.answer_md:
Pattern:
```yaml
- import_tasks: _remove_config.yaml
- block:
    - import_tasks: _populate.yaml
    - name: Override config
      register: result
      vyos.vyos.vyos_l3_interfaces:
        config: [...]
        state: overridden
    - assert:
        that:
          - overridden['commands'] | symmetric_difference(result['commands']) | length == 0
    - name: Override again (IDEMPOTENT)
      register: result
      vyos.vyos.vyos_l3_interfaces: { config: [...], state: overridden }
    - assert:
        that: [result is not changed]
  always:
    - import_tasks: _remove_config.yaml
```
